messages.author: Debarati DasGupta
messages.body:
Hi All,
When I use barostat=2 (MC barostat) I get this information at the end of output file.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
| MC Barostat: 20000 volume changes attempted.
| MC Barostat: 11124 changes successful ( 55.62%)
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
What to infer from this information? Is this something critical we should monitor at the end of each run?
Thanks
Debarati
